fieldValues.title: Structural authoring rules section in the spec language guide
fieldValues.summary: Adds a structural-rules section to docs/style/spec-language-guide.md, extending the existing prose-rule/registry split rather than adding a new document. Each relocated rule (contains single-parent, no forward depends-on, no orphan leaf, part-order, no baked heading, invariant placement, part-container membership, publication reachability) names the check that enforces it or is marked reviewer-enforced. Receives the rules cut by #818.
fieldValues.body:
Wave 2 unit (meaning-placement sweep). Blocked on #812 — that ruling licenses the relocation. Owner decision: extend docs/style/spec-language-guide.md, do not add a new document; it already pairs with scripts/spec-language-registry.json and already draws the checker-vs-reviewer distinction this needs.

Mode clear, non-normative (a style doc, no records touched) — gate:auto-merge on green once #812 has landed; does not merge before the ruling.
